2: The patient presented with gross hematuria and intermittent right pelvic pain. Imaging studies, including intravenous urography and retrograde ureteropyelography, revealed a tubular filling defect with partial obstruction of the right mid ureter, and flexible ureteroscopy showed a pedunculated ureteral tumor with a vulnerable surface. Although urine cytology and endoscopic biopsy were negative for malignancy, the clinical and imaging findings are consistent with a ureteral tumor.
